title: Subadditivity of local mass
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^P, and let X, Y, Z ∈ 𝒟_d(U) satisfy X(ω) = Y(ω) + Z(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U). Then M_V(X) ≤ M_V(Y) + M_V(Z) in [0, ∞], where M_V = massOn V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = Y ω + Z ω) → X.massOn V ≤ Y.massOn V + Z.massOn V
